name: dsh-png-pet
description: A Windows desktop pet companion for DeepSeek Harness.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir lib src/client.tsx
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/helper-process.test.mjs test/package-layout.test.mjs test/protocol.test.mjs test/companion-reducer.test.mjs test/dsh-event-adapter.test.mjs test/companion-bridge.test.mjs test/index.test.mjs test/wpf-layout.test.mjs test/dialogue-settings.test.mjs test/client-settings-model.test.mjs
